newsitem.title: USA: U.S. corporate bonds slow, Fort Howard, Qwest up.
newsitem.headline: U.S. corporate bonds slow, Fort Howard, Qwest up.

text.p: Credit-specific news events drove most activity among U.S. corporate bonds on Monday, as trading in the overall market remained sluggish, traders said.

Monday's announcement of the planned merger of James River Corp and Fort Howard Corp to create one of the world's largest tissue and paper product companies affected the prices of the bonds of both companies.
Seperately, Qwest Communications Corp, which is building a national fiber-optic telecommunications network, said that GTE Corp agreed to use its network to provide long-distance service.
